body: So disappointing. Not sure how this has 5 stars. You have a website www.novelhit.com on it it allows you to go to the App Store and download the app. But hmmm nothing is the same! No rewards available on the website. And no you can’t login in to the same login even if it has the same email. Website gave me 25 coins, app gave me 30 coins. Can’t even find the same book on both website and app. Feels like a big freakin scam. Even if I was willing to buy coins I’d rather buy an actual hardback limited edition of some Kind for $60 dollars! Come on you scammers!
Free for a few chapters, then watch ads for a few chapters, then that option goes away and only choice becomes ridiculously expensive to buy coins. Disappointing.

title: ⭐️buyer beware
body: I have requested and was denied credit for chapters I’ve read and have to continually re-unlock. I was told there’s nothing wrong. I’m telling you there is. Buyer beware!!!

title: Waste of money
body: Bough the coins just to see if it works with never gave me the coins on my account, just a waste of money

title: not worth it
body: you have to pay about $100 usd to get enough coins to read one single book. If you don’t pay you can check in daily to receive a whopping 5 coins while each chapter is about 75 coins on average. if you don’t want to pay you can also watch 6 ads to unlock each chapter. each chapter is literally only a min long so about 6 ads every other min.

title: 3 different stories
body: 2 1/2 separate books: names change repeatedly throughout each story. Combining villains, main characters and supporting characters. Several chapters in each story changes from actual writing to 1 or 2 key words that completely loses or muddies the story for 1-2 chapters usually a climatic chapter. Stories advertised for free are not free.

title: Awful
body: The story’s are good and the app works great but to unlock my entire story it would cost 4,900 coins 5000 coins cost 50 dollars. Like I can buy 4-5 physical books with that kinda of money.

title: Pay for everything
body: There is no option but to pay for every bit of everything. And the cost is much higher on this site than on others. The app-store says there are promos, etc but there is nothing like that on the app. Sadly disappointing. Some good starts on some stories, but plan to delete shortly.

title: Ads won’t load or take forever
body: It’s takes an average of 5-6 minutes for me to load an ad- it takes just as many times of me pressing “watch ad” only to get an error message . Wish they would fix this issue it’s making me not want to use this app .

title: Good stories, overpriced chapters/coins
body: The stories are good, and I like that you can watch an ad to get a free chapter. HOWEVER, it is ridiculous in my opinion that it says “4 ads” but within one ad it even says “ad 1/2”. So really you have to watch 8 ads for one chapter. I’ll continue with this app for a while like this until I get sick of it, but I’m guess it’s only gonna be 1-2 chapters before I’m sick of it and delete it. I’d suggest fixing the app to make it only show 4 ads during the ad play instead of the 1/2 ads per 1, or cut it to watching 2 ads and count it as 4. Cause again that’s just straight misleading and predatory since yall get paid per ad.

title: Too expensive
body: I really wanted to read a story, but I couldn’t get enough coins. The “subscription” doesn’t not give you any benefits and is a waste of money. I bought coins and it wasn’t enough to get me through one story. If I wanted to buy the story as a book it would have been over $50. That is ridiculous. Don’t even start with this app.

title: Could be better
body: I’ve not been able to read much on this app because there’s no way to earn coins to open chapters and in order to purchase I have to log into Apple,FaceBook or Google which i typically don’t do when “checking “ an app out. I’m normally on any app for weeks before I ever log into Apple to save progress

title: The stories are fine. The app is lacking
body: I haven’t been able to finish a story yet because I just can’t bring myself to pay a MINIMUM of $10 to buy enough coins to unlock a story with 24 chapters. You can buy an entire full length novel on kindle for less than that!! This is one of the few reading apps that doesn’t offer the opportunity to earn free coins for unlocking chapters. I’ll most likely be deleting this app and sticking to the ones that don’t charge an obscene amount of $$ to read short stories. Very disappointing.

title: Good stories but expensive
body: If it takes let’s say 5x to top up for reading credits, that’s upwards of $50 for one book.

title: Cancel subscription
body: Terrible!!! I’ve been trying to cancel the subscription as everyone else mentioned it’s not showing in my apple subscription. I’ve emailed them back and forth with the Customer ID I have with my email and still being charged. I called Apple because it’s linked to my Apple Card and that was no use either!!!!

title: Good stories
body: They have really good stories however advancing once you finish the free tractors requires you to pay that is a problem. They don’t give any other options. So there are a lot of stories. I probably will not finish reading.

title: This is the best reading app I have used, and here’s why:
body: I am highly engaged with an extensive collection of original library stories. To enhance user experience, a coin system is implemented, providing rewards in the form of free privileges. The platform ensures regular updates, with new chapters released punctually, reflecting the developers' commitment and reliability. Consequently, I have awarded a five-star rating. 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

title: Great books!
body: Lots of great books in all the tropes I love! Mafia, shifter, and billionaire romance included. Auctioned By Blood: Bound to My Brother’s Enemy is one I really enjoyed. I also loved Tempted by Darkness. Stories have a good range of variety and are written well. For some books you have to unlock later chapters but they also have many free books to read! There are also stories for teens as well that aren’t explicit. App is easy to use and simple in its design so it’s easy to navigate. Reading is really easy, all you have to do is scroll and it goes to the next chapter automatically. Overall, I enjoy reading the stories on this app!

title: Gateway to Great Stories
body: NovelHit is a fantastic app filled with engaging, well written novels that keep you hooked from the start. With frequent updates and a wide variety of genres, it’s the perfect place for anyone who loves discovering and reading quality stories in one simple app.
